scope: Registered later-gap variation. Physically overtook moving source lead and remained in alternate.
methodology: Round-trip native world XY footprint projection to Road 67. Dynamic source gap is true rear-to-front or front-to-rear bumper gap. Screen requires 15 m ahead, 12 m behind, two seconds of following room, and five seconds of closing time. Measured actor motions are 0.5 s directional displacements. Ego poses are native journal samples with rounded yaw and position. Longitudinal aero or hardware granularity is outside score. Sensors are independently listed using the contemporaneous native policy log.
